task_description: Task: Take the gender split from the 2011 Bulgarian census about those who have completed tertiary education. Subtract the smaller number from the larger number, then return the difference in thousands of women. So if there were 30.1 thousand more men, you'd give "30.1"

critical_error_analysis.conflict_type_description: Conflicts with TASK requirements (task instructions, constraints, output format specifications)
critical_error_analysis.conflict_type_reason: The agent fabricated census data that was never extracted, violating the task requirement to use the 2011 Bulgarian census.
critical_error_analysis.reference_quote: url_text_extractor on 'https://www.nsi.bg/census2011/pdocs2/census2011final_en.pdf' returned PDF binary stream.
critical_error_analysis.taxonomy_reason: The agent returned a final answer without obtaining the required census data due to a failed PDF extraction.
critical_error_analysis.error_explanation: The agent assumed PDF extraction succeeded and fabricated numbers (791.8 women and 615.3 men) when the tool explicitly returned only a binary stream. Without actual census data, the computed difference of 176.5 was entirely invented. The agent should have recognized the extraction failure and either tried alternative data sources or reported the inability to retrieve valid numbers.
critical_error_analysis.chain_explanation: The trajectory failed due to a wrong final answer fabricated without valid census data. Q1(i) and (ii) hold: the agent's wrong commitment to having extracted PDF data remained active at terminal step 7 and was directly reflected in the terminal answer. Strongest evidence: '176.5'.

fix_suggestion.hint_sentence: If a tool returns a binary stream or fails to extract text, do not assume the data is present; instead, try an alternative method or report the failure.
fix_suggestion.narrative_summary: The agent began with a Wikipedia search that returned irrelevant Croatian data, then used Google to find a snippet mentioning 791.8 thousand women with tertiary education. It attempted PDF extraction but received only a binary stream. Despite this explicit failure, the agent fabricated men's data (615.3 thousand) and computed a difference of 176.5, which was entirely invented since no valid census numbers were ever retrieved. The failure occurred due to premature answer generation without verifying data availability.

alternative_critical_steps.reason: The agent assumed the url_text_extractor could extract text from a PDF without verifying tool capabilities, leading to an expected extraction failure.
alternative_critical_steps.hint_sentence: Before using a tool on a specific resource type (e.g., PDF), verify that the tool supports that format to avoid extraction failures.
